info.title: QMGateway API
info.description: One account and one key for QMGateway services. The SMS service is available today: send SMS through your own Android gateway phones, track delivery, send one-time passwords and read statistics. Every request needs an API key in the X-API-Key header. Call the API from your server, never from a browser or an app.

get.description:
QMGateway is the platform; your account can use services, and the SMS Gateway is available today. This endpoint tells an integration who it is talking to and whether each service is ready, so you can check before you send. Call it when your application starts, or from a health check.

Today there is one service, sms. Its details include the plan, SMS left, how many phones you have and how many are online, and ready_to_send: true when the plan is active, SMS remain and a phone is online.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

post.description:
Queues an SMS for delivery by one of your gateway phones. The API answers 202 Accepted straight away: the message is queued, not yet sent. Follow it with the status endpoint or a webhook.

Send to one number with phone, or to up to 1,000 numbers with recipients. Each recipient becomes its own message with its own id.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Any unique string up to 100 characters. Repeating a request with the same key returns the original result and sends nothing twice.

error.message: Invalid phone number "099123". Write it with the country code, for example +265991234567, or as a local number that starts with 0, which is read as Malawi (+265).
Insufficient SMS balance: 3 SMS left. Renew or upgrade your plan.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

phone.description: The recipient: international format (+265991234567) or a local number that starts with 0 (0991234567), which is read with your organisation's country (Malawi unless you set another). See Phone numbers.

recipients.description: Between 1 and 1,000 numbers, in either format. The same number written two ways counts once.

message.description: The text, 1 to 1,600 characters. Long texts are split into parts and use more than one SMS unit (see Message length).

type.description: A label for your own reporting: transactional (default), otp, bulk or scheduled.

device_id.description: Send from this phone only (an id from List phones). Without it, QMGateway chooses a phone using your routing settings. A message with a device_id always stays with that phone.

scheduled_at.description: When to send, for example 2026-12-01T08:00:00+02:00. Include the time zone (Z or an offset such as +02:00); without one it is read as Malawi time. A time in the past sends immediately; more than 365 days ahead is refused. See Scheduling.

example.message: Your order #1052 is ready for collection.

get.description:
Returns the messages your organisation has sent, newest first. Use it to find what failed today, to check a customer's history, or to rebuild your own records after downtime. For one known message, Get a message is cheaper.

Pages work with before_id: pass the next_before_id from the last page to get the next one. next_before_id is null on the last page.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Pending, Scheduled, Sent to Gateway, Delivered, Failed or Cancelled.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Only messages to this number, in either format.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only messages created at or after this date or time.

parameters.name: before_id
parameters.description: Return messages older than this id (paging).

data.failure_reason: The network did not accept the message.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Returns the phones connected to your account with their state and how much is waiting for each. Use an id as device_id when you send a message to keep it on that phone.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Returns one message that belongs to your organisation. Poll it sparingly (every few seconds at most) or, better, use webhooks and let QMGateway tell you.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The message id returned when you sent it.

404.description: No such message in your organisation

example1.summary: No such message in your organisation

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

get.description:
Returns SMS received on your gateway phones, oldest first, so you can process them in order. The easiest way to react to replies as they happen is the sms.incoming webhook; use this endpoint to catch up after downtime or when you cannot receive webhooks.

Keep the highest id you have handled and pass it as after_id next time. Only plans that receive replies store them: receives tells you whether yours does.

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: Only messages with a larger id than this (paging and catching up).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Only messages from this number, in either format.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: QMGateway generates the code, sends it by SMS (from your gateway phone) or by email, and keeps only what it needs to check it. You never see or store the code. Keep the returned request_reference and ask the user for the code they received. Verifying works the same for both.

202.description: Accepted: the code is on its way (SMS)

example1.summary: Accepted: the code is on its way (SMS)

error.message: Your email OTP allowance for this month is used up. It resets on 2026-12-18.
Too many OTP requests. Try again later.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

channel.description: sms or email. If left out, it is email when you send only email, otherwise sms.

email.description: The address to send the code to. It counts against your plan's monthly email OTP allowance.

purpose.description: What the code is for, for example login or payment. Default verification. It is kept with the request for your records.

expiry_seconds.description: How long the code stays valid, 60 to 900 seconds (other values are adjusted into that range). Default 300 (5 minutes).

post.description: Checks a code against the reference you got from Send. A wrong code is a normal answer (verified: false), not an HTTP error.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Returns your organisation's message totals for a period, your plan balance and the latest messages. Good for dashboards.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: today (default), week, month, year or custom.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: First day of a custom period.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Last day of a custom period. Default today.

recent_messages.message: Your order #1052 is ready for collection.

error.message: period must be today, week, month, year, or custom.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

get.description: Returns the messages you scheduled with scheduled_at that have not started sending. Use it to show customers what is coming, or to find the id you need to cancel or move one. Once a message starts sending it leaves this list: follow it with the status endpoint.

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: For the next page: pass the next_after_id from the previous answer.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

post.description: Cancels a message that is still Scheduled. Its SMS are returned to your balance straight away. Only scheduled messages can be cancelled: one that has started sending cannot be recalled.

error.message: Only a message that is still Scheduled can be changed. This one is Delivered.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

id.description: The message id returned when you scheduled it.

post.description: Changes the send time of a message that is still Scheduled. The text, recipient and SMS already set aside stay the same. To send it now, cancel it and send a new message.

error.message: Choose a time at least a minute in the future. To send now, cancel it and send a new message.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

scheduled_at.description: The new time, at least one minute from now and no more than 365 days ahead, with a time zone.

get.description: Returns what is left of your current plan. Call it before a big send, or on a schedule, and warn your own team when level becomes low. The send response also shows remaining_units after every request.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: wait Retry-After seconds

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: qm_live_… for real messages, qm_test_… for the practice phone (messages endpoints only).

XRateLimitLimit.description: Requests allowed a minute on this endpoint.

XRateLimitRemaining.description: Requests left in the current minute.

XRateLimitReset.description: Unix time when the window resets.

XRequestID.description: Quote this when you contact support.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before trying again (429 only).

code.description: Stable machine-readable code. Branch on this, never on the message.

message.description: A sentence you can show to a person. It may be reworded.

request_id.description: Quote it when you contact support. Also the X-Request-ID header.

details.description: Extra facts for some codes, for example remaining_units.
